title: Your first agent in one file
tagline: One tool, one model, one runAgent call: a weather agent that asks for the tool and answers from its result.

keys.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
keys.why: The model behind the agent, on OpenAI.

keys.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
keys.why: The model behind the agent, on Anthropic.

keys.name: OMEGA_VERTEX_CREDS
keys.why: The model behind the agent, on Vertex AI.

disclosure.summary: Calls one model vendor to answer a weather question with one tool.
disclosure.network: Keyless: none. Live: your chosen model vendor only (OpenAI, Anthropic or Vertex AI).
disclosure.files: Writes a run log in a temporary folder and removes it when done.
disclosure.background: None. It exits when the answer is printed.
disclosure.credentials: Reads the one model key named under Keys needed for a live run. Stores nothing.
